units.title: Results
units.intro: Grammar focus: Result complements 完, 好, 懂, 到, 错

items.en: to hold; to grasp; handlebar; classifier: handful, bundle, bunch

ex.zh: 他好心地把我送到医院。
ex.p: tā hǎo xīn de bǎ wǒ sòng dào yī yuàn
ex.en: He was kind enough to take me to the hospital.

ex.zh: 他把眼镜落在我们这里了。
ex.p: tā bǎ yǎn jìng là zài wǒ men zhè lǐ le
ex.en: He left his glasses at our place.

items.en: quilt; to cover (with); (literary) to suffer (a misfortune)

ex.zh: 我被问到我是不是要这么做。
ex.p: wǒ bèi wèn dào wǒ shì bù shì yào zhè me zuò
ex.en: I was asked whether I wanted to do that.

ex.zh: 这被认为是一件大事。
ex.p: zhè bèi rèn wéi shì yī jiàn dà shì
ex.en: This is considered to be a matter of great importance.

items.en: as (in the capacity of); to take sth as; to act as

ex.zh: “为什么你不来？”“因为我不想。”
ex.p: wèi shén me nǐ bù lái yīn wèi wǒ bù xiǎng
ex.en: "Why aren't you going?" "Because I don't want to."

ex.zh: 为什么人们不总是讲真话？
ex.p: wèi shén me rén men bù zǒng shì jiǎng zhēn huà
ex.en: Why do people not always tell the truth?

ex.zh: 其中一个学生今天没来。
ex.p: qí zhōng yī gè xué sheng jīn tiān méi lái
ex.en: One of the students didn't come today.

ex.zh: 在雨中走出去是不可能的。
ex.p: zài yǔ zhōng zǒu chū qù shì bù kě néng de
ex.en: Going out in this rain is out of the question.

items.en: to use; to employ; to have to

ex.zh: 你用你的照相机做了什么？
ex.p: nǐ yòng nǐ de zhào xiàng jī zuò le shén me
ex.en: What did you do with your camera?

ex.zh: 我不知道用什么能打开它。
ex.p: wǒ bù zhī dào yòng shén me néng dǎ kāi tā
ex.en: I don't know what to open it with.

items.en: if; in case; in the event that

ex.zh: 如果你不想的话也没问题。
ex.p: rú guǒ nǐ bù xiǎng de huà yě méi wèn tí
ex.en: If you don't want to do it, you don't have to.

ex.zh: 如果你想要的话，你就拿吧。
ex.p: rú guǒ nǐ xiǎng yào de huà nǐ jiù ná ba
ex.en: If you want it, you can have it.

ex.zh: 我一天又一天地给她写信。
ex.p: wǒ yī tiān yòu yī tiān dì gěi tā xiě xìn
ex.en: I wrote her a letter every day.

ex.zh: 我又失去了一次机会。
ex.p: wǒ yòu shī qù le yī cì jī huì
ex.en: I've missed another chance.

items.en: (prefix) can; may; able to; -able; to approve; to permit; to suit

ex.zh: 人们可能不记得那件事了。
ex.p: rén men kě néng bù jì de nà jiàn shì le
ex.en: People may not remember that.

ex.zh: 你可能比你想的更聪明。
ex.p: nǐ kě néng bǐ nǐ xiǎng de gēng cōng ming
ex.en: You're probably smarter than you think.

ex.zh: 为什么我们应该要帮助？
ex.p: wèi shén me wǒ men yīng gāi yào bāng zhù
ex.en: Why should we help?

ex.zh: 他告诉我什么时候该说是。
ex.p: tā gào sù wǒ shén me shí hou gāi shuō shì
ex.en: He told me when to say yes.

items.en: to need; to want; to demand; to require; needs

ex.zh: 我有我需要的所有东西。
ex.p: wǒ yǒu wǒ xū yào de suǒ yǒu dōng xī
ex.en: I have everything I need.

ex.zh: 我现在真需要来杯喝的。
ex.p: wǒ xiàn zài zhēn xū yào lái bēi hē de
ex.en: I really need a drink now.

items.en: ability; talent; sb of a certain type; a capable individual

ex.zh: 这家里应该没有男人才对。
ex.p: zhè jiā lǐ yīng gāi méi yǒu nán rén cái duì
ex.en: There aren't supposed to be any men in this house.

ex.zh: 你想到几岁才结婚呢？
ex.p: nǐ xiǎng dào jī suì cái jié hūn ne
ex.en: At what age do you want to get married?

items.en: to resemble; to be like; to look as if

ex.zh: 你看起来像一个聪明人。
ex.p: nǐ kàn qǐ lai xiàng yī gè cōng ming rén
ex.en: You seem like a very smart person.

ex.zh: 你看起来很像你的哥哥。
ex.p: nǐ kàn qǐ lai hěn xiàng nǐ de gē ge
ex.en: You look just like your older brother.

ex.zh: 我们应该往哪个方向走？
ex.p: wǒ men yīng gāi wǎng nǎ gè fāng xiàng zǒu
ex.en: Which way should we go?

ex.zh: 为什么我要向你道歉？
ex.p: wèi shén me wǒ yào xiàng nǐ dào qiàn
ex.en: Why should I apologize to you?

items.en: to believe; to think; to consider; to feel

ex.zh: 他误认为我是一个英国人。
ex.p: tā wù rèn wéi wǒ shì yī gè yīng guó rén
ex.en: He took me for an Englishman.

ex.zh: 你为什么会认为我在想你？
ex.p: nǐ wèi shén me huì rèn wéi wǒ zài xiǎng nǐ
ex.en: Why do you think I'm thinking about you?

items.en: to rise; to raise; to get up

ex.zh: 他常和她一起去看电影。
ex.p: tā cháng hé tā yī qǐ qù kàn diàn yǐng
ex.en: He often goes with her to watch movies.

ex.zh: 他提议大家一起去游泳。
ex.p: tā tí yì dà jiā yī qǐ qù yóu yǒng
ex.en: He suggested that we go for a swim.

ex.zh: 你应该每天睡八个小时觉。
ex.p: nǐ yīng gāi měi tiān shuì bā gè xiǎo shí jué
ex.en: You should sleep for eight hours a day.

ex.zh: 你应该知道这是不可能的。
ex.p: nǐ yīng gāi zhī dào zhè shì bù kě néng de
ex.en: You should know that's impossible.

ex.zh: 她把书带回了图书馆。
ex.p: tā bǎ shū dài huí le tú shū guǎn
ex.en: She took the book back to the library.

ex.zh: 我没带眼镜就什么都看不到。
ex.p: wǒ méi dài yǎn jìng jiù shén me dōu kàn bù dào
ex.en: I can't see anything without my glasses.

ex.zh: 一个聪明人不会说这种话。
ex.p: yī gè cōng ming rén bù huì shuō zhè zhǒng huà
ex.en: A wise man would not say such a thing.

ex.zh: 不要再让这种事发生了！
ex.p: bù yào zài ràng zhè zhǒng shì fā shēng le
ex.en: Don't let that happen again!

items.en: to notice; to become aware of; to discover; to find; to detect; a discovery

ex.zh: 我发现读这本书很难。
ex.p: wǒ fā xiàn dòu zhè běn shū hěn nán
ex.en: I found it difficult to read the book.

ex.zh: 这只是我们发现的东西之一。
ex.p: zhè zhǐ shì wǒ men fā xiàn de dōng xī zhī yī
ex.en: This is only one of the things we found.

ex.zh: 我为什么一定要那么做？
ex.p: wǒ wèi shén me yī dìng yào nà me zuò
ex.en: Why do I have to do that?

ex.zh: 我早餐一定会喝牛奶。
ex.p: wǒ zǎo cān yī dìng huì hē niú nǎi
ex.en: I always drink milk with my breakfast.

ex.zh: 我们在一起生活了三年。
ex.p: wǒ men zài yī qǐ shēng huó le sān nián
ex.en: We lived together for three years.

ex.zh: 他们过着和平的生活。
ex.p: tā men guò zhe hé píng de shēng huó
ex.en: They live in peace.

items.en: to happen; to occur; to take place; to break out

ex.zh: 你真的相信那发生了吗？
ex.p: nǐ zhēn de xiāng xìn nà fā shēng le ma
ex.en: Do you really believe that's what happened?

ex.zh: 你知道发生了什么事情吗？
ex.p: nǐ zhī dào fā shēng le shén me shì qing ma
ex.en: Do you know what happened?

items.en: for; for the purpose of; in order to

ex.zh: 他这么说就是为了开玩笑。
ex.p: tā zhè me shuō jiù shì wèi le kāi wán xiào
ex.en: He said it merely as a joke.

ex.zh: 我们起得很早为了看到日出。
ex.p: wǒ men qǐ de hěn zǎo wèi le kàn dào rì chū
ex.en: We woke up very early in order to see the sunrise.

items.en: merely; only; just; nothing but; simply; but; however

ex.zh: 你不再只是一个孩子了。
ex.p: nǐ bù zài zhǐ shì yī gè hái zi le
ex.en: You're no longer a mere child.

ex.zh: 你要做的只是坐在这儿。
ex.p: nǐ yào zuò de zhǐ shì zuò zài zhèr
ex.en: All you have to do is sit here.

ex.zh: 世界末日是什么时候？
ex.p: shì jiè mò rì shì shén me shí hou
ex.en: When will the world come to an end?

ex.zh: 时间是世界上最宝贵的东西。
ex.p: shí jiān shì shì jiè shǎng zuì bǎo guì de dōng xī
ex.en: Time is the most precious thing in the world.

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar

HSK 3 · 第26单元

Results

Grammar focus: Result complements 完, 好, 懂, 到, 错

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 3 · 第31单元

Ongoing states

Grammar focus: 着; 正在…呢

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 他经常坐在我旁边听音乐。
sents.p: tā jīng cháng zuò zài wǒ páng biān yǐn yīn yuè

sents.zh: 她和一位音乐家结了婚。

sents.zh: 她坚持认为那是我的错。
sents.p: tā jiān chí rèn wéi nà shì wǒ de cuò

sents.zh: 事情没能如他所愿让他感到失望。
sents.p: shì qing méi néng rú tā suǒ yuàn ràng tā gǎn dào shī wàng
sents.en: He was disappointed that things didn't turn out as he'd hoped.

sents.en: Have you ever seen the man in this photo?

sents.p: wǒ de yín háng zhàng hù lǐ méi liú xià qián
sents.en: There's no money left in my bank account.

sents.zh: 你知道银行什么时候关门吗？
sents.p: nǐ zhī dào yín háng shén me shí hou guān mén ma
sents.en: Do you have any idea when the bank closes?

sents.p: tā de gù shì bù kě néng shì zhēn de
sents.en: His story can't be true.

sents.zh: 他跟我讲了他的人生故事。
sents.p: tā gēn wǒ jiǎng le tā de rén shēng gù shì
sents.en: He told me his life's story.

sents.zh: 在我看来，这个问题很难解决。
sents.p: zài wǒ kàn lai zhè gè wèn tí hěn nán jiě jué
sents.en: In my opinion, it would be difficult to solve this problem.

sents.p: kàn lai tā yǐ jīng shōu dào le qián

units.title: Sequence
units.intro: Grammar focus: 先…然后…; 以前 / 以后; …的时候

ex.zh: 那辆汽车真的很贵。
ex.p: nà liàng qì chē zhēn de hěn guì
ex.en: That car is really expensive.

ex.zh: 汽车准备好了。
ex.p: qì chē zhǔn bèi hǎo le
ex.en: The car is ready.

ex.zh: 我知道，我做了很可怕的事。
ex.p: wǒ zhī dào wǒ zuò le hěn kě pà de shì
ex.en: I know I did an awful thing.

ex.zh: 我怕你没法跟她结婚。
ex.p: wǒ pà nǐ méi fǎ gēn tā jié hūn

ex.p: nǐ men zhǔn bèi cān jiā huì yì ma

ex.zh: 我会参加下次的会议。
ex.p: wǒ huì cān jiā xià cì de huì yì

ex.p: nǐ yǐn le wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shang de jié mù ma

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 3 · 第32单元

Sequence

Grammar focus: 先…然后…; 以前 / 以后; …的时候

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 那辆汽车真的很贵。
sents.p: nà liàng qì chē zhēn de hěn guì
sents.en: That car is really expensive.

sents.zh: 汽车准备好了。
sents.p: qì chē zhǔn bèi hǎo le
sents.en: The car is ready.

sents.zh: 我知道，我做了很可怕的事。
sents.p: wǒ zhī dào wǒ zuò le hěn kě pà de shì
sents.en: I know I did an awful thing.

sents.zh: 我怕你没法跟她结婚。
sents.p: wǒ pà nǐ méi fǎ gēn tā jié hūn
sents.en: I'm afraid you can't marry her.

sents.zh: 你们准备参加会议吗？
sents.p: nǐ men zhǔn bèi cān jiā huì yì ma
sents.en: Are you planning to take part in the meeting?

sents.zh: 我会参加下次的会议。
sents.p: wǒ huì cān jiā xià cì de huì yì
sents.en: I'll attend the next meeting.

sents.zh: 你真的要试着那样做吗？
sents.p: nǐ zhēn de yào shì zhe nà yàng zuò ma
sents.en: Is it true you're trying to do that?

sents.zh: 我们试了三次，都失败了。
sents.p: wǒ men shì le sān cì dōu shī bài le
sents.en: We had three tries and failed each time.

sents.zh: 你听了我昨天晚上的节目吗？
sents.p: nǐ yǐn le wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shang de jié mù ma
sents.en: Did you hear my show last night?

sents.zh: 你能帮我给这些人分发节目单吗？
sents.p: nǐ néng bāng wǒ gěi zhè xiē rén fēn fā jié mù shàn ma
sents.en: Will you help me give out the programs to those people?

sents.zh: 她为她的家人准备健康餐。
sents.p: tā wèi tā de jiā rén zhǔn bèi jiàn kāng cān
sents.en: She prepares wholesome meals for her family.

sents.zh: 不用说，健康是重要的。
sents.p: bù yòng shuō jiàn kāng shì zhòng yào de
sents.en: It goes without saying that health is important.

sents.zh: 得不到的东西就最想得到。
sents.p: de bù dào de dōng xī jiù zuì xiǎng dé dào
sents.en: It is the things that we do not possess which seem to us most desirable.

sents.zh: 我没时间找你想要的东西。
sents.p: wǒ méi shí jiān zhǎo nǐ xiǎng yào de dōng xī
sents.en: I haven't had time to look for what you wanted.

sents.zh: 我爸爸经常去美国出差。
sents.p: wǒ bà ba jīng cháng qù měi guó chū chāi
sents.en: My father often goes to America on business.

sents.zh: 这些天我的视力正在变差。
sents.p: zhè xiē tiān wǒ de shì lì zhèng zài biàn chà
sents.en: My vision is getting worse these days.

sents.zh: 我想跟你这样的人结婚。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ zhè yàng de rén jié hūn
sents.en: I'd like to get married to someone like you.

sents.zh: 我的两个姐妹都结婚了。
sents.p: wǒ de liǎng gè jiě mèi dōu jié hūn le
sents.en: Both of my sisters are married.

sents.zh: 很不幸，没有人在身边。
sents.p: hěn bù xìng méi yǒu rén zài shēn biān
sents.en: Unfortunately, there was no one around.

sents.zh: 我希望你在我身边。
sents.p: wǒ xī wàng nǐ zài wǒ shēn biān
sents.en: I wish you were close to me.

sents.zh: 不可能短时间内学会英语。
sents.p: bù kě néng duǎn shí jiān nèi xué huì yīng yǔ
sents.en: It is impossible to master English in a short time.

sents.zh: 我该用短一点的用户名的。
sents.p: wǒ gāi yòng duǎn yī diǎn de yòng hù míng de
sents.en: I should've chosen a shorter username.

sents.zh: 他向她求婚，而她同意了。
sents.p: tā xiàng tā qiú hūn ér tā tóng yì le
sents.en: He asked her to marry him, and she accepted.

sents.zh: 怎么会有这么多的人同意呢？
sents.p: zěn me huì yǒu zhè me duō de rén tóng yì ne
sents.en: How could so many people go along with this?

sents.zh: 你们几乎什么都没有吃。
sents.p: nǐ men jī hū shén me dōu méi yǒu chī
sents.en: You hardly ate anything.

sents.zh: 我几乎每天都见到那条狗。
sents.p: wǒ jī hū měi tiān dōu jiàn dào nà tiáo gǒu
sents.en: I see that dog almost every day.

sents.zh: 在你的词典查一查这个词。
sents.p: zài nǐ de cí diǎn zhā yī zhā zhè gè cí
sents.en: Look up the word in your dictionary.

sents.zh: 我得查找一下我的笔。
sents.p: wǒ de chá zhǎo yī xià wǒ de bǐ
sents.en: I need to search for my pen.

sents.zh: 你不用再为我担心了。
sents.p: nǐ bù yòng zài wèi wǒ dān xīn le
sents.en: You don't need to worry about me anymore.

sents.zh: “谢谢你们。”“不用谢。”
sents.p: xiè xie nǐ men bù yòng xiè
sents.en: "Thanks, guys." "Don't mention it."

sents.zh: 我家附近有个漂亮的公园。
sents.p: wǒ jiā fù jìn yǒu gè piào liang de gōng yuán
sents.en: There is a beautiful park near my home.

sents.zh: 我希望住在你家附近。
sents.p: wǒ xī wàng zhù zài nǐ jiā fù jìn
sents.en: I wish I could live near your house.

sents.zh: 他们是认真的吗？
sents.p: tā men shì rèn zhēn de ma
sents.en: Were they serious?

sents.zh: 你们是认真的吗？
sents.p: nǐ men shì rèn zhēn de ma
sents.en: Were you guys serious?

sents.zh: 她家在一座山的山脚下。
sents.p: tā jiā zài yī zuò shān de shān jiǎo xià
sents.en: Her house is at the foot of a mountain.

sents.zh: 他停下脚步看起海报。
sents.p: tā tíng xià jiǎo bù kàn qǐ hǎi bào
sents.en: He paused to look at the poster.

sents.zh: 今天晚上我打算看电视。
sents.p: jīn tiān wǎn shang wǒ dǎ suàn kàn diàn shì
sents.en: I am going to watch TV this evening.

sents.zh: 你在电视上看足球赛了吗？
sents.p: nǐ zài diàn shì shǎng kàn zú qiú sài le ma
sents.en: Did you watch the soccer game on television?

sents.zh: 你怎么找到我的房子的？
sents.p: nǐ zěn me zhǎo dào wǒ de fáng zi de
sents.en: How did you find my house?

sents.zh: 我不该把我的房子卖了的。
sents.p: wǒ bù gāi bǎ wǒ de fáng zi mài le de
sents.en: I shouldn't have sold my house.

sents.zh: 我从没有爬过这座山。
sents.p: wǒ cóng méi yǒu pá guò zhè zuò shān
sents.en: I've never climbed this mountain.

sents.zh: 那辆山地车多少钱？
sents.p: nà liàng shān de chē duō shǎo qián
sents.en: How much is that mountain bike?

sents.zh: 你是在黑市上买的它吗？
sents.p: nǐ shì zài hēi shì shǎng mǎi de tā ma
sents.en: Did you buy it on the black market?

sents.zh: 我一点都不喜欢这个城市。
sents.p: wǒ yī diǎn dōu bù xǐ huan zhè gè chéng shì
sents.en: I don't like this city at all.

units.title: Conditions
units.intro: Grammar focus: 如果…就…; 只要…就…

items.en: for example; for instance; such as

ex.zh: 我本来想走的，但后来忘了。
ex.p: wǒ běn lái xiǎng zǒu de dàn hòu lái wàng le
ex.en: I intended to go, but forgot to.

ex.zh: 他是非常有想像力的作家。
ex.p: tā shì fēi cháng yǒu xiǎng xiàng lì de zuò jiā
ex.en: He is a very imaginative writer.

ex.zh: 她对她的孩子非常生气。
ex.p: tā duì tā de hái zi fēi cháng shēng qì
ex.en: She got very angry with her children.

ex.zh: 为什么你的嘴那么大？
ex.p: wèi shén me nǐ de zuǐ nà me dà
ex.en: Why is your mouth so big?

ex.zh: 嘴里有东西的时候不准说话。
ex.p: zuǐ lǐ yǒu dōng xī de shí hou bù zhǔn shuō huà
ex.en: Don't talk with your mouth full.

items.en: to meet; to run into; to come across

ex.zh: 你在车站遇到的男人是我爸。
ex.p: nǐ zài chē zhàn yù dào de nán rén shì wǒ bà
ex.en: The man you met at the station is my father.

ex.zh: 你认为我们会遇到好天气吗？
ex.p: nǐ rèn wéi wǒ men huì yù dào hǎo tiān qì ma
ex.en: Do you think we'll have good weather?

ex.zh: 你不能喝海水，因为它太咸了。
ex.p: nǐ bù néng hē hǎi shuǐ yīn wèi tā tài xián le
ex.en: You can't drink seawater because it's too salty.

ex.zh: 那些海报现在都到哪里去了？
ex.p: nà xiē hǎi bào xiàn zài dōu dào nǎ lǐ qù le
ex.en: Where are those posters now?

items.en: to jump; to hop; to skip over

ex.zh: 我感觉我的心跳得很快。
ex.p: wǒ gǎn jué wǒ de xīn tiào de hěn kuài
ex.en: I felt my heart beating rapidly.

ex.zh: 我最好的朋友舞跳得很好。
ex.p: wǒ zuì hǎo de péng you wǔ tiào de hěn hǎo
ex.en: My best friend dances really well.

items.en: to reply; to answer; reply; answer

ex.zh: 只有你回答了这个问题。
ex.p: zhǐ yǒu nǐ huí dá le zhè gè wèn tí
ex.en: Only you answered the question.

ex.zh: 我可以回答所有问题。
ex.p: wǒ kě yǐ huí dá suǒ yǒu wèn tí
ex.en: I could answer all the questions.

ex.zh: 你太年轻了，还不能做这个。
ex.p: nǐ tài nián qīng le hái bù néng zuò zhè gè
ex.en: You're too young to be doing that.

ex.zh: 她没她看上去那么年轻。
ex.p: tā méi tā kàn shang qu nà me nián qīng
ex.en: She is not as young as she looks.

ex.zh: 你不该让他们等那么久。
ex.p: nǐ bù gāi ràng tā men děng nà me jiǔ
ex.en: You shouldn't keep them waiting so long.

ex.zh: 你们两个在一起多久了？
ex.p: nǐ men liǎng gè zài yī qǐ duō jiǔ le
ex.en: How long have you two been together?

items.en: to record; to note; to memorize

ex.zh: 他把这记在他的笔记本上。
ex.p: tā bǎ zhè jì zài tā de bǐ jì běn shǎng
ex.en: He wrote it down in his notebook.

ex.zh: 我忘记他叫什么名字了。
ex.p: wǒ wàng jì tā jiào shén me míng zi le
ex.en: I forgot what his name was.

items.en: to pay attention to; to follow sth closely; to follow (on social media)

ex.zh: 我感觉大家都在关注我。
ex.p: wǒ gǎn jué dà jiā dōu zài guān zhù wǒ
ex.en: I feel like everybody's watching me.

ex.zh: 谢谢您的关注。
ex.p: xiè xie nín de guān zhù
ex.en: Thank you for your attention.

ex.zh: 你关心他们在想什么吗？
ex.p: nǐ guān xīn tā men zài xiǎng shén me ma
ex.en: Do you care what they think?

ex.zh: 关于那个你有什么看法？
ex.p: guān yú nà gè nǐ yǒu shén me kàn fǎ
ex.en: What do you think about it?

ex.zh: 孩子们应该每天喝牛奶。
ex.p: hái zi men yīng gāi měi tiān hē niú nǎi
ex.en: Children should drink milk every day.

ex.zh: 现在女生穿牛仔裤很流行。
ex.p: xiàn zài nǚ shēng chuān niú zǎi kù hěn liú xíng
ex.en: Jeans are now in fashion among girls.

ex.zh: 我刚才起床了。
ex.p: wǒ gāng cái qǐ chuáng le
ex.en: I just got up.

ex.zh: 我刚才在家。
ex.p: wǒ gāng cái zài jiā
ex.en: I was at home.

ex.zh: 有一天，我会跑得像风一样快。
ex.p: yǒu yī tiān wǒ huì páo de xiàng fēng yī yàng kuài
ex.en: Someday I'll run like the wind.

ex.zh: 昨天一点风也没有。
ex.p: zuó tiān yī diǎn fēng yě méi yǒu
ex.en: There was no wind at all yesterday.

ex.zh: 下午请到我办公室来。
ex.p: xià wǔ qǐng dào wǒ bàn gōng shì lái
ex.en: Please come to my office in the afternoon.

ex.zh: 办公室的门是黄色的。
ex.p: bàn gōng shì de mén shì huáng sè de
ex.en: The door of the office is yellow.

ex.zh: 我们可以在大楼里拍照吗？
ex.p: wǒ men kě yǐ zài dà lóu lǐ pāi zhào ma
ex.en: Is it all right to take pictures in this building?

ex.zh: 爸爸给我买了一个照相机。
ex.p: bà ba gěi wǒ mǎi le yī gè zhào xiàng jī
ex.en: Dad bought me a camera.

ex.zh: 他很快就适应了新环境。
ex.p: tā hěn kuài jiù shì yìng le xīn huán jìng
ex.en: He quickly accustomed himself to his new surroundings.

ex.zh: 我适应新环境很慢。
ex.p: wǒ shì yìng xīn huán jìng hěn màn
ex.en: I'm slow to adapt to new situations.

ex.zh: 我今天收到了她的信。
ex.p: wǒ jīn tiān shōu dào le tā de xìn
ex.en: I got a letter from her today.

ex.zh: 我们没有收到过道歉。
ex.p: wǒ men méi yǒu shōu dào guò dào qiàn
ex.en: We didn't get an apology.

ex.zh: 你一点方向感都没有。
ex.p: nǐ yī diǎn fāng xiàng gǎn dōu méi yǒu
ex.en: You have no sense of direction.

ex.zh: 你的方向感很好。
ex.p: nǐ de fāng xiàng gǎn hěn hǎo
ex.en: You have a really good sense of direction.

items.en: to be concerned about; to care about

ex.zh: 我很关心他的健康。
ex.p: wǒ hěn guān xīn tā de jiàn kāng
ex.en: I am very concerned about his health.

ex.zh: 你关心他们在想什么吗？
ex.p: nǐ guān xīn tā men zài xiǎng shén me ma
ex.en: Do you care what they think?

ex.zh: 这样做你能节约几个小时。
ex.p: zhè yàng zuò nǐ néng jié yuē jī gè xiǎo shí
ex.en: If you do it this way, you can save several hours.

ex.zh: 今天是情人节
ex.p: jīn tiān shì qíng rén jiē
ex.en: Today is Valentine's Day.

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 3 · 第33单元

Conditions

Grammar focus: 如果…就…; 只要…就…

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 我本来想走的，但后来忘了。
sents.p: wǒ běn lái xiǎng zǒu de dàn hòu lái wàng le
sents.en: I intended to go, but forgot to.

sents.zh: 他是非常有想像力的作家。
sents.p: tā shì fēi cháng yǒu xiǎng xiàng lì de zuò jiā
sents.en: He is a very imaginative writer.

sents.zh: 她对她的孩子非常生气。
sents.p: tā duì tā de hái zi fēi cháng shēng qì
sents.en: She got very angry with her children.

sents.zh: 为什么你的嘴那么大？
sents.p: wèi shén me nǐ de zuǐ nà me dà
sents.en: Why is your mouth so big?

sents.zh: 嘴里有东西的时候不准说话。
sents.p: zuǐ lǐ yǒu dōng xī de shí hou bù zhǔn shuō huà
sents.en: Don't talk with your mouth full.

sents.zh: 你在车站遇到的男人是我爸。
sents.p: nǐ zài chē zhàn yù dào de nán rén shì wǒ bà
sents.en: The man you met at the station is my father.

sents.zh: 你认为我们会遇到好天气吗？
sents.p: nǐ rèn wéi wǒ men huì yù dào hǎo tiān qì ma
sents.en: Do you think we'll have good weather?

sents.zh: 你不能喝海水，因为它太咸了。
sents.p: nǐ bù néng hē hǎi shuǐ yīn wèi tā tài xián le
sents.en: You can't drink seawater because it's too salty.

sents.zh: 那些海报现在都到哪里去了？
sents.p: nà xiē hǎi bào xiàn zài dōu dào nǎ lǐ qù le
sents.en: Where are those posters now?

sents.zh: 我感觉我的心跳得很快。
sents.p: wǒ gǎn jué wǒ de xīn tiào de hěn kuài
sents.en: I felt my heart beating rapidly.

sents.zh: 我最好的朋友舞跳得很好。
sents.p: wǒ zuì hǎo de péng you wǔ tiào de hěn hǎo
sents.en: My best friend dances really well.

sents.zh: 只有你回答了这个问题。
sents.p: zhǐ yǒu nǐ huí dá le zhè gè wèn tí
sents.en: Only you answered the question.

sents.zh: 我可以回答所有问题。
sents.p: wǒ kě yǐ huí dá suǒ yǒu wèn tí
sents.en: I could answer all the questions.

sents.zh: 你太年轻了，还不能做这个。
sents.p: nǐ tài nián qīng le hái bù néng zuò zhè gè
sents.en: You're too young to be doing that.

sents.zh: 她没她看上去那么年轻。
sents.p: tā méi tā kàn shang qu nà me nián qīng
sents.en: She is not as young as she looks.

sents.zh: 你不该让他们等那么久。
sents.p: nǐ bù gāi ràng tā men děng nà me jiǔ
sents.en: You shouldn't keep them waiting so long.

sents.zh: 你们两个在一起多久了？
sents.p: nǐ men liǎng gè zài yī qǐ duō jiǔ le
sents.en: How long have you two been together?

sents.zh: 他把这记在他的笔记本上。
sents.p: tā bǎ zhè jì zài tā de bǐ jì běn shǎng
sents.en: He wrote it down in his notebook.

sents.zh: 我忘记他叫什么名字了。
sents.p: wǒ wàng jì tā jiào shén me míng zi le
sents.en: I forgot what his name was.

sents.zh: 我感觉大家都在关注我。
sents.p: wǒ gǎn jué dà jiā dōu zài guān zhù wǒ
sents.en: I feel like everybody's watching me.

sents.zh: 谢谢您的关注。
sents.p: xiè xie nín de guān zhù
sents.en: Thank you for your attention.

sents.zh: 你关心他们在想什么吗？
sents.p: nǐ guān xīn tā men zài xiǎng shén me ma
sents.en: Do you care what they think?

sents.zh: 关于那个你有什么看法？
sents.p: guān yú nà gè nǐ yǒu shén me kàn fǎ
sents.en: What do you think about it?

sents.zh: 孩子们应该每天喝牛奶。
sents.p: hái zi men yīng gāi měi tiān hē niú nǎi
sents.en: Children should drink milk every day.

sents.zh: 现在女生穿牛仔裤很流行。
sents.p: xiàn zài nǚ shēng chuān niú zǎi kù hěn liú xíng
sents.en: Jeans are now in fashion among girls.

sents.zh: 我刚才起床了。
sents.p: wǒ gāng cái qǐ chuáng le
sents.en: I just got up.

sents.zh: 我刚才在家。
sents.p: wǒ gāng cái zài jiā
sents.en: I was at home.

sents.zh: 有一天，我会跑得像风一样快。
sents.p: yǒu yī tiān wǒ huì páo de xiàng fēng yī yàng kuài
sents.en: Someday I'll run like the wind.

sents.zh: 昨天一点风也没有。
sents.p: zuó tiān yī diǎn fēng yě méi yǒu
sents.en: There was no wind at all yesterday.

sents.zh: 下午请到我办公室来。
sents.p: xià wǔ qǐng dào wǒ bàn gōng shì lái
sents.en: Please come to my office in the afternoon.

sents.zh: 办公室的门是黄色的。
sents.p: bàn gōng shì de mén shì huáng sè de
sents.en: The door of the office is yellow.

sents.zh: 我们可以在大楼里拍照吗？
sents.p: wǒ men kě yǐ zài dà lóu lǐ pāi zhào ma
sents.en: Is it all right to take pictures in this building?

sents.zh: 爸爸给我买了一个照相机。
sents.p: bà ba gěi wǒ mǎi le yī gè zhào xiàng jī
sents.en: Dad bought me a camera.

sents.zh: 他很快就适应了新环境。
sents.p: tā hěn kuài jiù shì yìng le xīn huán jìng
sents.en: He quickly accustomed himself to his new surroundings.

sents.zh: 我适应新环境很慢。
sents.p: wǒ shì yìng xīn huán jìng hěn màn
sents.en: I'm slow to adapt to new situations.

sents.zh: 我今天收到了她的信。
sents.p: wǒ jīn tiān shōu dào le tā de xìn
sents.en: I got a letter from her today.

sents.zh: 我们没有收到过道歉。
sents.p: wǒ men méi yǒu shōu dào guò dào qiàn
sents.en: We didn't get an apology.

sents.zh: 你一点方向感都没有。
sents.p: nǐ yī diǎn fāng xiàng gǎn dōu méi yǒu
sents.en: You have no sense of direction.

sents.zh: 你的方向感很好。
sents.p: nǐ de fāng xiàng gǎn hěn hǎo
sents.en: You have a really good sense of direction.

sents.zh: 我很关心他的健康。
sents.p: wǒ hěn guān xīn tā de jiàn kāng
sents.en: I am very concerned about his health.

sents.zh: 这样做你能节约几个小时。
sents.p: zhè yàng zuò nǐ néng jié yuē jī gè xiǎo shí
sents.en: If you do it this way, you can save several hours.

sents.zh: 今天是情人节
sents.p: jīn tiān shì qíng rén jiē
sents.en: Today is Valentine's Day.

units.title: Contrast
units.intro: Grammar focus: 虽然…但是…; 可是; 不过

ex.zh: 这只不过全是个大误会而已。
ex.p: zhè zhǐ bù guò quán shì gè dà wù huì ér yǐ
ex.en: It's all just a big misunderstanding.

ex.zh: 他不过是个孩子。
ex.p: tā bù guò shì gè hái zi
ex.en: He is but a child.

items.en: to pile on top of one another; layer; stratum; floor (of a building); story

ex.zh: 我爱千层面。
ex.p: wǒ ài qiān céng miàn
ex.en: I love lasagna.

ex.zh: 医生给他的病人开了一些药。
ex.p: yī shēng gěi tā de bìng rén kāi le yī xiē yào
ex.en: The physician prescribed his patient some medicine.

ex.zh: 我的腿有什么毛病？
ex.p: wǒ de tuǐ yǒu shén me máo bìng
ex.en: What's wrong with my legs?

ex.zh: 你有着漂亮的腿。
ex.p: nǐ yǒu zhe piào liang de tuǐ
ex.en: You have beautiful legs.

ex.zh: 我在街上遇到他。
ex.p: wǒ zài jiē shǎng yù dào tā
ex.en: I met him on the street.

ex.zh: 我家离这里五个街区远。
ex.p: wǒ jiā chī zhè lǐ wǔ gè jiē oū yuǎn
ex.en: My house is five blocks away.

items.en: one side; either side; on the one hand

ex.zh: 我丈夫一边吃早餐一边读报纸。
ex.p: wǒ zhàng fu yī biān chī zǎo cān yī biān dòu bào zhǐ
ex.en: My husband reads the newspaper while eating breakfast.

ex.zh: 他一边唱歌一边工作。
ex.p: tā yī biān chàng gē yī biān gōng zuò
ex.en: He sang while working.

ex.zh: 这双鞋对我来说太大了。
ex.p: zhè shuāng xié duì wǒ lái shuō tài dà le
ex.en: These shoes are too big for me.

ex.zh: 她花很多钱在买鞋上。
ex.p: tā huā hěn duō qián zài mǎi xié shǎng
ex.en: She spends a lot of money on shoes.

ex.zh: 你很快就会习惯住在这里。
ex.p: nǐ hěn kuài jiù huì xí guàn zhù zài zhè lǐ
ex.en: You'll get used to living here in no time.

ex.zh: 我现在已经习惯它了。
ex.p: wǒ xiàn zài yǐ jīng xí guàn tā le
ex.en: I'm used to it by now.

items.en: (intransitive) to change; to vary; change; variation

ex.zh: 我爸爸会在这周末回家。
ex.p: wǒ bà ba huì zài zhè zhōu mò huí jiā
ex.en: My father will come home at the end of this week.

ex.zh: 你的周末是怎么过的？
ex.p: nǐ de zhōu mò shì zěn me guò de
ex.en: How did you spend your weekend?

items.en: to hear (sth said); one hears (that); hearsay

ex.zh: 从没有人听说过这件事。
ex.p: cóng méi yǒu rén tīng shuō guò zhè jiàn shì
ex.en: Nobody had ever heard of it.

ex.zh: 我从没听说过这个演员。
ex.p: wǒ cóng méi tīng shuō guò zhè gè yǎn yuán
ex.en: I've never heard of this actor.

ex.zh: 我会等在这儿直到他回来。
ex.p: wǒ huì děng zài zhèr zhí dào tā huí lai
ex.en: I'll wait here till he comes back.

ex.zh: 坚持下去直到我找到你。
ex.p: jiān chí xià qù zhí dào wǒ zhǎo dào nǐ
ex.en: Hang on till I get to you.

ex.zh: 你觉得这件毛衣怎么样？
ex.p: nǐ jué de zhè jiàn máo yī zěn me yàng
ex.en: What do you think of this sweater?

ex.zh: 请问下，这件毛衣要多少钱？
ex.p: qǐng wèn xià zhè jiàn máo yī yào duō shǎo qián
ex.en: Excuse me, how much is this sweater?

ex.zh: 我永远不会忘记您的帮助。
ex.p: wǒ yǒng yuǎn bù huì wàng jì nín de bāng zhù
ex.en: I'll never forget how helpful you've been.

ex.zh: 他忘记给她买过一个礼物了。
ex.p: tā wàng jì gěi tā mǎi guò yī gè lǐ wù le
ex.en: He forgot that he bought her a present.

ex.zh: 看起来我们是在一条船上。
ex.p: kàn qǐ lai wǒ men shì zài yī tiáo chuán shǎng
ex.en: It seems we are in the same boat.

ex.zh: 船和火车哪个跑得快？
ex.p: chuán hé huǒ chē nǎ gè páo de kuài
ex.en: Which goes faster, a ship or a train?

items.en: to raise (animals); to bring up (children); to keep (pets)

ex.zh: 他们收养了那个小女孩。
ex.p: tā men shōu yǎng le nà gè xiǎo nǚ hái
ex.en: They adopted the little girl.

ex.zh: 我们今天得去养老院唱歌。
ex.p: wǒ men jīn tiān de qù yǎng lǎo yuàn chàng gē
ex.en: We have to sing at an old folks home today.

ex.zh: 我买了几个鸡蛋和一点牛奶。
ex.p: wǒ mǎi le jī gè jī dàn hé yī diǎn niú nǎi
ex.en: I bought a few eggs and a little milk.

ex.zh: 请问鸡蛋要什么做法？
ex.p: qǐng wèn jī dàn yào shén me zuò fǎ
ex.en: How would you like your eggs?

ex.zh: 他把信读了一遍又一遍。
ex.p: tā bǎ xìn dòu le yī biàn yòu yī biàn
ex.en: He read the letter over and over.

ex.zh: 不好意思，能请您重复一遍吗？
ex.p: bù hǎo yì si néng qǐng nín chóng fù yī biàn ma
ex.en: I beg your pardon?

ex.zh: 我会在我的办公室里。
ex.p: wǒ huì zài wǒ de bàn gōng shì lǐ
ex.en: I'll be in my office.

ex.zh: 我明天十点起会在办公室里。
ex.p: wǒ míng tiān shí diǎn qǐ huì zài bàn gōng shì lǐ
ex.en: I'll be in my office from ten tomorrow.

ex.zh: 她的英语好极了。
ex.p: tā de yīng yǔ hǎo jí le
ex.en: Her English is excellent.

ex.zh: 北极熊正在死去。
ex.p: běi jí xióng zhèng zài sǐ qù
ex.en: The polar bears are dying.

items.en: we or us (including both the speaker and the person(s) spoken to)

ex.zh: 咱们吃吧！我饿死了。
ex.p: zán men chī ba wǒ è sǐ le
ex.en: Let's eat now. I'm starving.

ex.zh: 这都是咱们听说的。
ex.p: zhè dōu shì zán men tīng shuō de
ex.en: That’s what we heard.

items.en: to be careful; to take care

ex.zh: 你应该更小心的。
ex.p: nǐ yīng gāi gēng xiǎo xīn de
ex.en: You should've been more careful.

ex.zh: 小心不要感冒了。
ex.p: xiǎo xīn bù yào gǎn mào le
ex.en: Be careful not to catch a cold.

ex.zh: 我不知道该怎么办。
ex.p: wǒ bù zhī dào gāi zěn me bàn
ex.en: I have no idea of what to do.

ex.zh: 我们现在怎么办？
ex.p: wǒ men xiàn zài zěn me bàn
ex.en: What do we do now?

sents.en: Nobody had ever heard of it.

sents.zh: 我从没听说过这个演员。
sents.p: wǒ cóng méi tīng shuō guò zhè gè yǎn yuán
sents.en: I've never heard of this actor.

sents.zh: 我会等在这儿直到他回来。
sents.p: wǒ huì děng zài zhèr zhí dào tā huí lai
sents.en: I'll wait here till he comes back.

sents.zh: 坚持下去直到我找到你。
sents.p: jiān chí xià qù zhí dào wǒ zhǎo dào nǐ
sents.en: Hang on till I get to you.

sents.zh: 你觉得这件毛衣怎么样？
sents.p: nǐ jué de zhè jiàn máo yī zěn me yàng
sents.en: What do you think of this sweater?

sents.zh: 请问下，这件毛衣要多少钱？
sents.p: qǐng wèn xià zhè jiàn máo yī yào duō shǎo qián
sents.en: Excuse me, how much is this sweater?

sents.zh: 我永远不会忘记您的帮助。
sents.p: wǒ yǒng yuǎn bù huì wàng jì nín de bāng zhù
sents.en: I'll never forget how helpful you've been.

sents.zh: 他忘记给她买过一个礼物了。
sents.p: tā wàng jì gěi tā mǎi guò yī gè lǐ wù le
sents.en: He forgot that he bought her a present.

sents.zh: 看起来我们是在一条船上。
sents.p: kàn qǐ lai wǒ men shì zài yī tiáo chuán shǎng
sents.en: It seems we are in the same boat.

sents.zh: 船和火车哪个跑得快？
sents.p: chuán hé huǒ chē nǎ gè páo de kuài
sents.en: Which goes faster, a ship or a train?

sents.zh: 他们收养了那个小女孩。
sents.p: tā men shōu yǎng le nà gè xiǎo nǚ hái
sents.en: They adopted the little girl.

sents.zh: 我们今天得去养老院唱歌。
sents.p: wǒ men jīn tiān de qù yǎng lǎo yuàn chàng gē
sents.en: We have to sing at an old folks home today.

sents.zh: 我买了几个鸡蛋和一点牛奶。
sents.p: wǒ mǎi le jī gè jī dàn hé yī diǎn niú nǎi
sents.en: I bought a few eggs and a little milk.

sents.zh: 请问鸡蛋要什么做法？
sents.p: qǐng wèn jī dàn yào shén me zuò fǎ
sents.en: How would you like your eggs?

sents.zh: 他把信读了一遍又一遍。
sents.p: tā bǎ xìn dòu le yī biàn yòu yī biàn
sents.en: He read the letter over and over.

sents.zh: 不好意思，能请您重复一遍吗？
sents.p: bù hǎo yì si néng qǐng nín chóng fù yī biàn ma
sents.en: I beg your pardon?

sents.zh: 我会在我的办公室里。
sents.p: wǒ huì zài wǒ de bàn gōng shì lǐ
sents.en: I'll be in my office.

sents.zh: 我明天十点起会在办公室里。
sents.p: wǒ míng tiān shí diǎn qǐ huì zài bàn gōng shì lǐ
sents.en: I'll be in my office from ten tomorrow.

sents.zh: 她的英语好极了。
sents.p: tā de yīng yǔ hǎo jí le
sents.en: Her English is excellent.

sents.zh: 北极熊正在死去。
sents.p: běi jí xióng zhèng zài sǐ qù
sents.en: The polar bears are dying.

sents.zh: 咱们吃吧！我饿死了。
sents.p: zán men chī ba wǒ è sǐ le
sents.en: Let's eat now. I'm starving.

sents.zh: 这都是咱们听说的。
sents.p: zhè dōu shì zán men tīng shuō de
sents.en: That’s what we heard.

sents.zh: 你应该更小心的。
sents.p: nǐ yīng gāi gēng xiǎo xīn de
sents.en: You should've been more careful.

sents.zh: 小心不要感冒了。
sents.p: xiǎo xīn bù yào gǎn mào le
sents.en: Be careful not to catch a cold.

sents.zh: 我不知道该怎么办。
sents.p: wǒ bù zhī dào gāi zěn me bàn
sents.en: I have no idea of what to do.

sents.zh: 我们现在怎么办？
sents.p: wǒ men xiàn zài zěn me bàn
sents.en: What do we do now?

sents.en: I understand that you feel uneasy, but don't worry.

sents.zh: 这么着急干什么。
sents.p: zhè me zháo jí gàn shén me
sents.en: What's the rush?

sents.zh: 那天我丢了我的照相机。
sents.p: nà tiān wǒ diū le wǒ de zhào xiàng jī
sents.en: I lost my camera the other day.

sents.zh: 我好像丢了我的钥匙。
sents.p: wǒ hǎo xiàng diū le wǒ de yào shi
sents.en: It seems that I've lost my keys.

sents.zh: 她奇怪地看了我一眼。
sents.p: tā qí guài de kàn le wǒ yī yǎn
sents.en: She gave me a strange look.

sents.zh: 我看见那儿有个奇怪的女人。
sents.p: wǒ kàn jiàn nàr yǒu gè qí guài de nǚ rén
sents.en: I saw a strange woman there.

sents.zh: 他们互相送礼物给对方。
sents.p: tā men hù xiāng sòng lǐ wù gěi duì fāng
sents.en: They give presents to one another.

sents.zh: 谢谢你送给我儿子礼物。
sents.p: xiè xie nǐ sòng gěi wǒ ér zi lǐ wù
sents.en: Thank you for the present you gave my son.

sents.zh: 你是我最好的朋友之一。
sents.p: nǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péng you zhī yī
sents.en: You're one of my best friends.

sents.zh: 现在是买它的最好时机。
sents.p: xiàn zài shì mǎi tā de zuì hǎo shí jī
sents.en: Now is a great time to buy one of those.

sents.zh: 指南针的指针指向北边。
sents.p: zhǐ nán zhēn de zhǐ zhēn zhǐ xiàng běi biān
sents.en: Compass needles point to the north.

sents.zh: 指南针指向北边。
sents.p: zhǐ nán zhēn zhǐ xiàng běi biān
sents.en: The compass points to the north.

sents.zh: 第一班火车什么时候出发？
sents.p: dì yī bān huǒ chē shén me shí hou chū fā
sents.en: What time does the first train leave?

sents.zh: 那么，女孩们，是时候出发了。
sents.p: nà me nǚ hái men shì shí hou chū fā le
sents.en: Well, girls, it's time to go.

ex.zh: 你为什么想学习那门语言？

ex.en: Why do you want to learn that language?

ex.zh: 在美国人们说哪些语言？
ex.p: zài měi guó rén men shuō nǎ xiē yǔ yán
ex.en: What languages are spoken in America?

ex.zh: 为什么没人来我的网站呢？
ex.p: wèi shén me méi rén lái wǒ de wǎng zhàn ne
ex.en: Why is no one visiting my website?

ex.zh: 我第一次知道这个网站。
ex.p: wǒ dì yī cì zhī dào zhè gè wǎng zhàn
ex.en: This is the first time I've heard of this website.

ex.zh: 您介不介意我把灯关了？
ex.p: nín jiè bù jiè yì wǒ bǎ dēng guān le
ex.en: Do you mind if I turn off the light?

ex.zh: 把灯打开。我什么都看不见了。
ex.p: bǎ dēng dǎ kāi wǒ shén me dōu kàn bù jiàn le
ex.en: Switch on the light. I can't see anything.

ex.zh: 在冬天，太阳下山比往常更早。
ex.p: zài dōng tiān tài yang xià shān bǐ wǎng cháng gēng zǎo
ex.en: The sun sets earlier in the winter.

ex.en: Neptune is the eighth planet of the solar system.

ex.zh: 你什么时候方便？

ex.en: When is it convenient for you?

ex.p: wǒ yào qù fāng biàn yī xià

ex.p: wǒ cóng méi yǒu pá guò zhè zuò shān

ex.zh: 她差不多和你一样高。

ex.zh: 差不多该去学校了。

ex.en: It's about time to go to school.

Softening and vividness

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 3 · 第38单元

Frequency and timing

Grammar focus: 经常, 一直, 刚 / 刚才, 马上

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 我从这里什么也看不见。
sents.p: wǒ cóng zhè lǐ shén me yě kàn bù jiàn
sents.en: I can't see anything from here.

sents.zh: 我听得见你，但我看不见你。
sents.p: wǒ yǐn de jiàn nǐ dàn wǒ kàn bù jiàn nǐ
sents.en: I hear you, but I don't see you.

sents.zh: 你必须把桌子清理干净。
sents.p: nǐ bì xū bǎ zhuō zi qīng lǐ gān jìng
sents.en: You must clear the table.

sents.zh: 这张桌子是干净的。
sents.p: zhè zhāng zhuō zi shì gān jìng de
sents.en: This table is clean.

sents.zh: 不要走在草地上。
sents.p: bù yào zǒu zài cǎo dì shǎng
sents.en: Stay off the grass.

sents.zh: 草地看来不错。
sents.p: cǎo dì kàn lai bù cuò
sents.en: The grass looks nice.

sents.zh: 我想吃点不甜的东西。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng chī diǎn bù tián de dōng xī
sents.en: I want to eat something that isn't sweet.

sents.zh: 这个蛋糕太甜了。
sents.p: zhè gè dàn gāo tài tián le
sents.en: The cake is too sweet.

sents.zh: 我所想要的是一点平和和安静。
sents.p: wǒ suǒ xiǎng yào de shì yī diǎn píng hé hé ān jìng
sents.en: What I want is some peace and quiet.

sents.zh: 你该安静几天。
sents.p: nǐ gāi ān jìng jī tiān
sents.en: You must keep quiet for a few days.

sents.zh: 我知道她是西班牙人。
sents.p: wǒ zhī dào tā shì xī bān yá rén
sents.en: I know that she is Spanish.

sents.zh: 西班牙语是她的母语。
sents.p: xī bān yá yǔ shì tā de mǔ yǔ
sents.en: Spanish is her native language.

sents.zh: 抱歉，我把作业落在家里了。
sents.p: bào qiàn wǒ bǎ zuò yè là zài jiā lǐ le
sents.en: I'm sorry, I left my homework at home.

sents.zh: 对不起，我忘了作业这回事了。
sents.p: duì bù qǐ wǒ wàng le zuò yè zhè huí shì le
sents.en: I'm sorry, I forgot to do my homework.

sents.zh: 我瘦了三公斤。
sents.p: wǒ shòu le sān gōng jīn
sents.en: I lost three kilograms.

sents.zh: 我去和朋友喝了杯啤酒。
sents.p: wǒ qù hé péng you hē le bēi pí jiǔ
sents.en: I went to drink a beer with friends.

sents.zh: 再来一杯啤酒怎么样？
sents.p: zài lái yī bēi pí jiǔ zěn me yàng
sents.en: How about another beer?

sents.zh: 每个人都想分一点蛋糕。
sents.p: měi gè rén dōu xiǎng fēn yī diǎn dàn gāo
sents.en: Everyone wanted a piece of the cake.

sents.zh: 这些蛋糕中我最喜欢这个。
sents.p: zhè xiē dàn gāo zhōng wǒ zuì xǐ huan zhè gè
sents.en: Out of these cakes, I like this one the best.

sents.zh: 我们晚饭后吃新鲜水果。
sents.p: wǒ men wǎn fàn hòu chī xīn xiān shuǐ guǒ
sents.en: We ate fresh fruit after dinner.

sents.zh: 我想要一些新鲜的鸡蛋。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng yào yī xiē xīn xiān de jī dàn
sents.en: I want some fresh eggs.

sents.zh: 我知道你难过。
sents.p: wǒ zhī dào nǐ nán guò
sents.en: I know you're upset.

sents.zh: 你在难过吗？
sents.p: nǐ zài nán guò ma
sents.en: Are you sad?

sents.zh: 不久就要吃正餐了。
sents.p: bù jiǔ jiù yào chī zhēng cān le
sents.en: It'll soon be time for dinner.

sents.zh: 可能不久会见你
sents.p: kě néng bù jiǔ huì jiàn nǐ
sents.en: Maybe I'll see you later.

sents.zh: 她给客人看了她的宝宝。
sents.p: tā gěi kè rén kàn le tā de bǎo bao
sents.en: She showed the visitor her baby.

sents.zh: 那家店有很多客人。
sents.p: nà jiā diàn yǒu hěn duō kè rén
sents.en: That shop has many customers.

sents.zh: 我爸爸常常洗碗。
sents.p: wǒ bà ba cháng cháng xǐ wǎn
sents.en: My father often washes the dishes.

sents.zh: 她常常感冒。
sents.p: tā cháng cháng gǎn mào
sents.en: She caught colds often.

sents.zh: 今天比平时还忙。
sents.p: jīn tiān bǐ píng shí hái máng
sents.en: Today's even busier than normal.

sents.zh: 大多数男生喜欢电脑游戏。
sents.p: dà duō shù nán shēng xǐ huan diàn nǎo yóu xì
sents.en: Most boys like computer games.

sents.zh: 他是最高的男生。
sents.p: tā shì zuì gāo de nán shēng
sents.en: He is the tallest boy.

sents.zh: 我的工作是洗碗。
sents.p: wǒ de gōng zuò shì xǐ wǎn
sents.en: My job is to wash dishes.

sents.zh: 洗碗是我的工作。
sents.p: xǐ wǎn shì wǒ de gōng zuò
sents.en: My job is to wash the dishes.

sents.zh: 好久不见。听说你又换工作了？
sents.p: hǎo jiǔ bù jiàn tīng shuō nǐ yòu huàn gōng zuò le
sents.en: Long time, no see. I hear that you've changed your job again.

sents.zh: 我们在公园等了好久。
sents.p: wǒ men zài gōng yuán děng le hǎo jiǔ
sents.en: We waited in the park for a long time.

sents.zh: 夏天过得怎么样？
sents.p: xià tiān guò de zěn me yàng
sents.en: How was your summer?

sents.zh: 日本的夏天很热。
sents.p: rì běn de xià tiān hěn rè
sents.en: It is very hot in the summer in Japan.

sents.zh: 他喜欢数学，但我不喜欢。
sents.p: tā xǐ huan shù xué dàn wǒ bù xǐ huan
sents.en: He likes math, but I don't.

sents.zh: 大多数学生步行去学校。
sents.p: dà duō shù xué sheng bù xíng qù xué xiào
sents.en: Most students walk to school.

units.title: Approximation
units.intro: Grammar focus: 左右; 多 (三十多); 几 (几十)

ex.zh: 一个人只能活七十岁左右。
ex.p: yī gè rén zhǐ néng huó qī shí suì zuǒ yòu
ex.en: Humans only live about 70 years.

ex.zh: 他六点左右要给我打电话。
ex.p: tā liù diǎn zuǒ yòu yào gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà
ex.en: He will call for me about six.

items.en: to brush; to paint; to daub

ex.zh: 他把他的自行车刷成红色。
ex.p: tā bǎ tā de zì xíng chē shuā chéng hóng sè
ex.en: He painted his bicycle red.

ex.zh: 他把天花板刷成了蓝色。
ex.p: tā bǎ tiān huā bǎn shuā chéng le lán sè
ex.en: He painted the ceiling blue.

ex.zh: 几乎没有人认为我们是姐妹。
ex.p: jī hū méi yǒu rén rèn wéi wǒ men shì jiě mèi
ex.en: Almost nobody thinks we're sisters.

ex.zh: 他和他的姐妹们目前都住在东京。
ex.p: tā hé tā de jiě mèi men mù qián dōu zhù zài dōng jīng
ex.en: He and his sisters are currently living in Tokyo.

items.en: south; the southern part of the country; the South
to taste; to try (food); to experience; (literary) ever; once

ex.zh: 我所有的尝试都失败了。
ex.p: wǒ suǒ yǒu de cháng shì dōu shī bài le
ex.en: All of my attempts have failed.

ex.zh: 如果你尝试的话，你会成功的。
ex.p: rú guǒ nǐ cháng shì de huà nǐ huì chéng gōng de
ex.en: You'll succeed if you try.

ex.zh: 去年冬天很暖和。
ex.p: qù nián dōng tiān hěn nuǎn huo
ex.en: We had a mild winter last year.

ex.zh: 我不喜欢冬天。
ex.p: wǒ bù xǐ huan dōng tiān
ex.en: I don't like winter.

ex.zh: 我和我的邻居关系很好。
ex.p: wǒ hé wǒ de lín jū guān xi hěn hǎo
ex.en: I'm on good terms with the neighbors.

ex.zh: 我认识我所有的邻居。
ex.p: wǒ rèn shi wǒ suǒ yǒu de lín jū
ex.en: I know all my neighbors.

ex.zh: 我校校长很老了。
ex.p: wǒ xiào xiào zhǎng hěn lǎo le
ex.en: Our school's principal is very old.

ex.zh: 我能借一下您的自行车吗？
ex.p: wǒ néng jiè yī xià nín de zì xíng chē ma
ex.en: May I borrow your bike?

ex.zh: 你能把你的自行车借给我吗？
ex.p: nǐ néng bǎ nǐ de zì xíng chē jiè gěi wǒ ma
ex.en: Can you lend me your bicycle?

items.en: camera (abbr. for 照相机); at the opportune moment; as the circumstances allow

ex.zh: 我今晚能借你的数码相机吗？
ex.p: wǒ jīn wǎn néng jiè nǐ de shù mǎ xiàng jī ma
ex.en: Can I borrow your digital camera tonight?

ex.zh: 别忘了带个相机。
ex.p: bié wàng le dài gè xiàng jī
ex.en: Don't forget to take a camera.

ex.zh: 她帮她爸爸干了花园里的活。
ex.p: tā bāng tā bà ba gàn le huā yuán lǐ de huó
ex.en: She helped her father with the work in the garden.

ex.zh: 我爸爸在花园里。
ex.p: wǒ bà ba zài huā yuán lǐ
ex.en: My father's in the garden.

ex.zh: 我遇见一个朋友。
ex.p: wǒ yù jiàn yī gè péng you
ex.en: I met a friend.

ex.zh: 我没有遇见她。
ex.p: wǒ méi yǒu yù jiàn tā
ex.en: I haven't met her.

ex.zh: 我们用耳朵听。
ex.p: wǒ men yòng ěr duo yǐn
ex.en: We hear with our ears.

ex.zh: 你最喜欢的饮料是什么？
ex.p: nǐ zuì xǐ huan de yǐn liào shì shén me
ex.en: What's your favorite drink?

ex.zh: 我可以为你调杯热饮料吗？
ex.p: wǒ kě yǐ wèi nǐ diào bēi rè yǐn liào ma
ex.en: Can I fix you a hot drink?

ex.zh: 他的叔叔五年前去世了。
ex.p: tā de shū shu wǔ nián qián qù shì le
ex.en: His uncle died five years ago.

ex.zh: 你叔叔让你开他的车了吗？
ex.p: nǐ shū shu ràng nǐ kāi tā de chē le ma
ex.en: Did your uncle let you drive his car?

items.en: to bathe; to take a shower

ex.zh: 在我洗澡的时候，电话响了。
ex.p: zài wǒ xǐ zǎo de shí hou diàn huà xiǎng le
ex.en: I was in the bath when the phone rang.

ex.zh: 我在洗澡的时候，电话响了。
ex.p: wǒ zài xǐ zǎo de shí hou diàn huà xiǎng le
ex.en: The phone rang while I was taking a shower.

ex.zh: 来看看世界地图。
ex.p: lái kàn kàn shì jiè dì tú
ex.en: Have a look at the world map.

ex.zh: 我在这张地图上的哪里？
ex.p: wǒ zài zhè zhāng dì tú shǎng de nǎ lǐ
ex.en: Where am I on this map?

ex.zh: 这张沙发起码可以坐三个人。

ex.zh: 我们想买张沙发。

ex.zh: 你现在是名人了。

items.en: to scrape; to blow; to shave

ex.zh: 我对你刮目相看了。

ex.en: I'm seeing you in a new light.

ex.zh: 文件被风刮起来。
ex.p: wén jiàn bèi fēng guā qǐ lai
ex.en: The papers blew off.

ex.zh: 他把这记在他的笔记本上。

ex.zh: 我买了很多笔记本。
ex.p: wǒ mǎi le hěn duō bǐ jì běn
ex.en: I bought many notebooks.

ex.zh: 我妹妹比你矮。
ex.p: wǒ mèi mei bǐ nǐ ǎi
ex.en: My sister is shorter than you.

ex.zh: 我可以用哪些信用卡？
ex.p: wǒ kě yǐ yòng nǎ xiē xìn yòng kǎ
ex.en: Which credit cards can I use?

ex.zh: 你收到了我发的邮件了吗？
ex.p: nǐ shōu dào le wǒ fā de yóu jiàn le ma
ex.en: Did you get my letter?

ex.zh: 我只想查一下我的电子邮件。
ex.p: wǒ zhǐ xiǎng zhā yī xià wǒ de diàn zǐ yóu jiàn
ex.en: I just wanted to check my email.

ex.zh: 冰箱里什么也没有了。
ex.p: bīng xiāng lǐ shén me yě méi yǒu le
ex.en: There's nothing left in the fridge.

ex.zh: 冰箱是空的。
ex.p: bīng xiāng shì kōng de
ex.en: The fridge is empty.

ex.zh: 在美国，校车是黄色的。
ex.p: zài měi guó xiào chē shì huáng sè de
ex.en: In the United States, school buses are yellow.

ex.zh: 办公室的门是黄色的。
ex.p: bàn gōng shì de mén shì huáng sè de
ex.en: The door of the office is yellow.

items.en: to like; to love; to be fond of

ex.zh: 秋天是我最喜爱的季节。
ex.p: qiū tiān shì wǒ zuì xǐ ài de jì jié
ex.en: Fall is my favorite season.

ex.zh: 谁是你最喜爱的电视明星？
ex.p: shéi shì nǐ zuì xǐ ài de diàn shì míng xīng
ex.en: Who's your favorite TV star?

items.en: to hold a meeting; to attend a meeting

ex.zh: 茶点过后我们接着开会。
ex.p: chá diǎn guò hòu wǒ men jiē zhe kāi huì
ex.en: We will continue the meeting after some light refreshments.

ex.zh: 我现在必须去开会。
ex.p: wǒ xiàn zài bì xū qù kāi huì
ex.en: I have to go to a meeting now.

ex.zh: 这是我的电子邮箱。
ex.p: zhè shì wǒ de diàn zǐ yóu xiāng
ex.en: This is my email address.

ex.zh: 星期天不是我的工作日。
ex.p: xīng qī tiān bù shì wǒ de gōng zuò rì
ex.en: Sunday is not a workday for me.

units.title: Body and change
units.intro: Grammar focus: 越来越; 越…越…

ex.zh: 天空变得越来越暗了。
ex.p: tiān kōng biàn de yuè lái yuè àn le
ex.en: The sky grew darker and darker.

ex.zh: 白天变得越来越长。
ex.p: bái tiān biàn de yuè lái yuè cháng
ex.en: The days are getting longer and longer.

ex.zh: 您怎么让屋子暖起来？
ex.p: nín zěn me ràng wū zi nuǎn qǐ lai
ex.en: How do you heat the house?

ex.zh: 我们在找一个漂亮的屋子住。
ex.p: wǒ men zài zhǎo yī gè piào liang de wū zi zhù
ex.en: We're looking for a nice house to live in.

items.en: the West; the Occident; Western countries

ex.zh: 春天和秋天，你更喜欢哪个？
ex.p: chūn tiān hé qiū tiān nǐ gēng xǐ huan nǎ gè
ex.en: Which do you prefer, spring or autumn?

ex.zh: 我爸爸明年春天就要退休了。
ex.p: wǒ bà ba míng nián chūn tiān jiù yào tuì xiū le
ex.en: My father is retiring next spring.

items.en: to worry; to feel anxious; to feel a sense of urgency; to be in a hurry

ex.zh: 你不要着急。
ex.p: nǐ bù yào zháo jí
ex.en: Don't worry.

ex.zh: 别那么着急。
ex.p: bié nà me zháo jí
ex.en: Don't worry so much.

items.en: to be in hospital; to be hospitalized

ex.zh: 她休假期间花了一大笔钱。
ex.p: tā xiū jià qī jiān huā le yī dà bǐ qián
ex.en: She spent a good deal of money on her vacation.

ex.zh: 好久没有休一个真正的假期了。
ex.p: hǎo jiǔ méi yǒu xiū yī gè zhēn zhèng de jià qī le
ex.en: It's been a long time since I've had a real vacation.

ex.zh: 他不得不打扫了他的房间。
ex.p: tā bù dé bù dǎ sǎo le tā de fáng jiān
ex.en: He had to clean his room.

ex.zh: 我应该打扫我的房间。
ex.p: wǒ yīng gāi dǎ sǎo wǒ de fáng jiān
ex.en: I should clean my room.

ex.zh: 我看见一条脏狗进了花园。
ex.p: wǒ kàn jiàn yī tiáo zàng gǒu jìn le huā yuán
ex.en: I saw a dirty dog enter the garden.

ex.zh: 她想洗脏衣服。
ex.p: tā xiǎng xǐ zàng yī fu
ex.en: She wanted to wash the dirty clothes.

ex.zh: 一年之中，你最喜欢哪个季节？
ex.p: yī nián zhī zhōng nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ gè jì jié
ex.en: What's your favorite season of the year?

ex.zh: 您最喜欢哪个季节？
ex.p: nín zuì xǐ huan nǎ gè jì jié
ex.en: What season do you like the best?

ex.zh: 我已经吃饱了，谢谢。
ex.p: wǒ yǐ jīng chī bǎo le xiè xie
ex.en: I'm already full, thank you.

ex.zh: 我已经很饱了，谢谢。
ex.p: wǒ yǐ jīng hěn bǎo le xiè xie
ex.en: I'm already full, thank you.

ex.zh: 我夏天没有空调会死。
ex.p: wǒ xià tiān méi yǒu kōng tiáo huì sǐ
ex.en: I can't survive without air conditioning in the summer.

ex.zh: 你一共花了多少钱？
ex.p: nǐ yī gòng huā le duō shǎo qián
ex.en: What is the total amount of money you spent?

ex.zh: 这个夏天我胖了两公斤。
ex.p: zhè gè xià tiān wǒ pán le liǎng gōng jīn
ex.en: I gained two kilos this summer.

ex.zh: 马是种很有用的动物。
ex.p: mǎ shì zhǒng hěn yǒu yòng de dòng wù
ex.en: Horses are useful animals.

ex.zh: 你求他帮忙没有用。
ex.p: nǐ qiú tā bāng máng méi yǒu yòng
ex.en: It's no use your begging him for help.

ex.zh: 您今天下午想不想去动物园？
ex.p: nín jīn tiān xià wǔ xiǎng bù xiǎng qù dòng wù yuán
ex.en: Would you like to go to the zoo this afternoon?

ex.zh: 我们在公园里跑了步。
ex.p: wǒ men zài gōng yuán lǐ páo le bù
ex.en: We ran in the park.

items.en: north; the northern part a country; China north of the Yellow River

ex.zh: 我的其中一个行李不见了。
ex.p: wǒ de qí zhōng yī gè xíng li bù jiàn le
ex.en: One of my suitcases is missing.

ex.zh: 请问您有多少件行李？
ex.p: qǐng wèn nín yǒu duō shǎo jiàn xíng li
ex.en: How many pieces of baggage do you have?

ex.zh: 我要一件新衬衫。你想要什么？
ex.p: wǒ yào yī jiàn xīn chèn shān nǐ xiǎng yào shén me
ex.en: I want a new shirt. What do you want?

ex.zh: 我的衬衫还没干。
ex.p: wǒ de chèn shān hái méi gàn
ex.en: My shirt isn't dry yet.

Body and change

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 天空变得越来越暗了。
sents.p: tiān kōng biàn de yuè lái yuè àn le
sents.en: The sky grew darker and darker.

sents.zh: 白天变得越来越长。
sents.p: bái tiān biàn de yuè lái yuè cháng
sents.en: The days are getting longer and longer.

sents.zh: 您怎么让屋子暖起来？
sents.p: nín zěn me ràng wū zi nuǎn qǐ lai
sents.en: How do you heat the house?

sents.zh: 我们在找一个漂亮的屋子住。
sents.p: wǒ men zài zhǎo yī gè piào liang de wū zi zhù
sents.en: We're looking for a nice house to live in.

sents.zh: 春天和秋天，你更喜欢哪个？
sents.p: chūn tiān hé qiū tiān nǐ gēng xǐ huan nǎ gè
sents.en: Which do you prefer, spring or autumn?

sents.zh: 我爸爸明年春天就要退休了。
sents.p: wǒ bà ba míng nián chūn tiān jiù yào tuì xiū le
sents.en: My father is retiring next spring.

sents.zh: 你不要着急。
sents.p: nǐ bù yào zháo jí
sents.en: Don't worry.

sents.zh: 别那么着急。
sents.p: bié nà me zháo jí
sents.en: Don't worry so much.

sents.zh: 她休假期间花了一大笔钱。
sents.p: tā xiū jià qī jiān huā le yī dà bǐ qián
sents.en: She spent a good deal of money on her vacation.

sents.zh: 好久没有休一个真正的假期了。
sents.p: hǎo jiǔ méi yǒu xiū yī gè zhēn zhèng de jià qī le
sents.en: It's been a long time since I've had a real vacation.

sents.zh: 他不得不打扫了他的房间。
sents.p: tā bù dé bù dǎ sǎo le tā de fáng jiān
sents.en: He had to clean his room.

sents.zh: 我应该打扫我的房间。
sents.p: wǒ yīng gāi dǎ sǎo wǒ de fáng jiān
sents.en: I should clean my room.

sents.zh: 我看见一条脏狗进了花园。
sents.p: wǒ kàn jiàn yī tiáo zàng gǒu jìn le huā yuán
sents.en: I saw a dirty dog enter the garden.

sents.zh: 她想洗脏衣服。
sents.p: tā xiǎng xǐ zàng yī fu
sents.en: She wanted to wash the dirty clothes.

sents.zh: 一年之中，你最喜欢哪个季节？
sents.p: yī nián zhī zhōng nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ gè jì jié
sents.en: What's your favorite season of the year?

sents.zh: 您最喜欢哪个季节？
sents.p: nín zuì xǐ huan nǎ gè jì jié
sents.en: What season do you like the best?

sents.zh: 我已经吃饱了，谢谢。
sents.p: wǒ yǐ jīng chī bǎo le xiè xie
sents.en: I'm already full, thank you.

sents.zh: 我已经很饱了，谢谢。
sents.p: wǒ yǐ jīng hěn bǎo le xiè xie
sents.en: I'm already full, thank you.

sents.zh: 我夏天没有空调会死。
sents.p: wǒ xià tiān méi yǒu kōng tiáo huì sǐ
sents.en: I can't survive without air conditioning in the summer.

sents.zh: 你一共花了多少钱？
sents.p: nǐ yī gòng huā le duō shǎo qián
sents.en: What is the total amount of money you spent?

sents.zh: 这个夏天我胖了两公斤。
sents.p: zhè gè xià tiān wǒ pán le liǎng gōng jīn
sents.en: I gained two kilos this summer.

sents.zh: 马是种很有用的动物。
sents.p: mǎ shì zhǒng hěn yǒu yòng de dòng wù
sents.en: Horses are useful animals.

sents.zh: 你求他帮忙没有用。
sents.p: nǐ qiú tā bāng máng méi yǒu yòng
sents.en: It's no use your begging him for help.

sents.zh: 您今天下午想不想去动物园？
sents.p: nín jīn tiān xià wǔ xiǎng bù xiǎng qù dòng wù yuán
sents.en: Would you like to go to the zoo this afternoon?

sents.zh: 我们在公园里跑了步。
sents.p: wǒ men zài gōng yuán lǐ páo le bù
sents.en: We ran in the park.

sents.zh: 我的其中一个行李不见了。
sents.p: wǒ de qí zhōng yī gè xíng li bù jiàn le
sents.en: One of my suitcases is missing.

sents.zh: 请问您有多少件行李？
sents.p: qǐng wèn nín yǒu duō shǎo jiàn xíng li
sents.en: How many pieces of baggage do you have?

sents.zh: 我要一件新衬衫。你想要什么？
sents.p: wǒ yào yī jiàn xīn chèn shān nǐ xiǎng yào shén me
sents.en: I want a new shirt. What do you want?

sents.zh: 我的衬衫还没干。
sents.p: wǒ de chèn shān hái méi gàn
sents.en: My shirt isn't dry yet.

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 3 · 第43单元

Travel and culture

Grammar focus: 为了; 得 (děi, must)

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 我想复习英语。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng fù xí yīng yǔ
sents.en: I would like to brush up my English.

sents.zh: 现在是秋天。
sents.p: xiàn zài shì qiū tiān
sents.en: It's fall now.

sents.zh: 春天和秋天，你更喜欢哪个？
sents.p: chūn tiān hé qiū tiān nǐ gēng xǐ huan nǎ gè
sents.en: Which do you prefer, spring or autumn?

sents.zh: 请把您的护照给我看一下。
sents.p: qǐng bǎ nín de hù zhào gěi wǒ kàn yī xià
sents.en: Show me your passport, please.

sents.zh: 你应该带护照去银行。
sents.p: nǐ yīng gāi dài hù zhào qù yín háng
sents.en: You should bring your passport to the bank.

sents.zh: 你放学以后干什么？
sents.p: nǐ fàng xué yǐ hòu gàn shén me
sents.en: What do you do after school?

sents.zh: 放学后我打了网球。
sents.p: fàng xué hòu wǒ dá le wǎng qiú
sents.en: I played tennis after school.

sents.zh: 我当时在卫生间。
sents.p: wǒ dāng shí zài wèi shēng jiān
sents.en: I was in the bathroom.

sents.zh: 再过两周你就可以出院了。
sents.p: zài guò liǎng zhōu nǐ jiù kě yǐ chū yuàn le
sents.en: In another two weeks you will be able to get out of the hospital.

sents.zh: 我下个月要搬家了。
sents.p: wǒ xià gè yuè yào bān jiā le
sents.en: I'm moving next month.

sents.zh: 你应该做笔记。
sents.p: nǐ yīng gāi zuò bǐ jì
sents.en: You should make notes.

sents.zh: 我看了自己的笔记。
sents.p: wǒ kàn le zì jǐ de bǐ jì
sents.en: I looked at my notes.

sents.zh: 我在外地生活了很久。
sents.p: wǒ zài wài dì shēng huó le hěn jiǔ
sents.en: I've lived away from home for a long time.

sents.zh: 你今天可以休假一天。
sents.p: nǐ jīn tiān kě yǐ xiū jià yī tiān
sents.en: You can take today off.

sents.zh: 她休假期间花了一大笔钱。
sents.p: tā xiū jià qī jiān huā le yī dà bǐ qián
sents.en: She spent a good deal of money on her vacation.

sents.zh: 前天，他们离开了那儿。
sents.p: qián tiān tā men lí kāi le nàr
sents.en: They left there the day before yesterday.

sents.zh: 事故发生在前天。
sents.p: shì gù fā shēng zài qián tiān
sents.en: The accident happened the day before yesterday.

units.title: Opinions
units.intro: Grammar focus: 觉得 vs 认为; 好像; 一定

items.en: (of trains etc) late; delayed; behind schedule

ex.zh: 我现在在上班，所以晚点打给你。
ex.p: wǒ xiàn zài zài shàng bān suǒ yǐ wǎn diǎn dá gěi nǐ
ex.en: I'm at work now, so I'll call you later.

ex.zh: 因为我不是很饿，所以我决定晚点吃。
ex.p: yīn wèi wǒ bù shì hěn è suǒ yǐ wǒ jué dìng wǎn diǎn chī
ex.en: I wasn't very hungry, so I decided to eat later.

ex.zh: 你有照相机吗？
ex.p: nǐ yǒu zhào xiàng jī ma
ex.en: Do you have a camera?

ex.zh: 你用你的照相机做了什么？
ex.p: nǐ yòng nǐ de zhào xiàng jī zuò le shén me
ex.en: What did you do with your camera?

ex.zh: 你们今天下午想不想去动物园？
ex.p: nǐ men jīn tiān xià wǔ xiǎng bù xiǎng qù dòng wù yuán
ex.en: Would you like to go to the zoo this afternoon?

ex.zh: 我昨天去了动物园。
ex.p: wǒ zuó tiān qù le dòng wù yuán
ex.en: I went to the zoo yesterday.

ex.zh: 我们坐在草地上吧。
ex.p: wǒ men zuò zài cǎo dì shǎng ba
ex.en: Let's sit on the grass.

ex.zh: 不要走在草地上。
ex.p: bù yào zǒu zài cǎo dì shǎng
ex.en: Stay off the grass.

ex.zh: 这是一种西瓜。
ex.p: zhè shì yī zhǒng xī guā
ex.en: This is a kind of watermelon.

ex.zh: 我能用一下你的铅笔吗？
ex.p: wǒ néng yòng yī xià nǐ de qiān bǐ ma
ex.en: Can I borrow your pencil for a bit?

ex.zh: 如果你需要铅笔，我借你一支。
ex.p: rú guǒ nǐ xū yào qiān bǐ wǒ jiè nǐ yī zhī
ex.en: If you want a pencil, I'll lend you one.

items.en: to recognize; to remember sth (or sb) on seeing it; to know

ex.zh: 房子里面的人我一个也不认得。
ex.p: fáng zi lǐ miàn de rén wǒ yī gè yě bù rèn de
ex.en: I didn't recognize anyone in the room.

items.en: to turn off (a machine or device); to finish shooting a film
the day after tomorrow; acquired (not innate or congenital); a posteriori

ex.zh: 我们后天出发。
ex.p: wǒ men hòu tiān chū fā
ex.en: We're leaving the day after tomorrow.

ex.zh: 你的狗看起来口渴了。
ex.p: nǐ de gǒu kàn qǐ lai kǒu kě le
ex.en: It looks like your dog is thirsty.

ex.zh: 我现在不特别渴。
ex.p: wǒ xiàn zài bù tè bié kě
ex.en: I'm not particularly thirsty right now.

ex.zh: 我经常用那本词典找单词。
ex.p: wǒ jīng cháng yòng nà běn cí diǎn zhǎo shàn cí
ex.en: I often look up words in that dictionary.

items.en: to give a dinner party; to entertain guests; to invite to dinner

ex.zh: 今天是我请客。
ex.p: jīn tiān shì wǒ qǐng kè
ex.en: Today is my treat.

ex.zh: 晚饭我请客。
ex.p: wǎn fàn wǒ qǐng kè
ex.en: I'll treat you to dinner.

ex.zh: 你不懂这句句子，不是吗？
ex.p: nǐ bù dǒng zhè gōu jù zi bù shì ma
ex.en: You can't understand this sentence, can you?

ex.zh: 新的班级怎么样？
ex.p: xīn de bān jí zěn me yàng
ex.en: How is your new class?

ex.zh: 用筷子吃饭难吗？
ex.p: yòng kuài zi chī fàn nán ma
ex.en: Is eating with chopsticks difficult?

ex.zh: 她穿着一条很难看的裙子。
ex.p: tā chuān zhuó yī tiáo hěn nán kàn de qún zi
ex.en: She was wearing an ugly dress.

ex.zh: 你们对外语感兴趣吗？
ex.p: nǐ men duì wài yǔ gǎn xìng qù ma
ex.en: Are you interested in foreign languages?

ex.zh: 精通一门外语需要很长时间。
ex.p: jīng tōng yī mén wài yǔ xū yào hěn cháng shí jiān
ex.en: It takes us a long time to master a foreign language.

items.en: a piece; a chunk; (coll.) one yuan; one dollar

ex.zh: 你对音乐感不感兴趣？
ex.p: nǐ duì yīn yuè gǎn bù gǎn xìng qù
ex.en: Are you interested in music?

ex.zh: 你对语言感兴趣吗？
ex.p: nǐ duì yǔ yán gǎn xìng qù ma
ex.en: Are you interested in languages?

units.title: Telling a story
units.intro: Grammar focus: 突然, 终于, 后来; 才 vs 就

items.en: to start an engine; to boot up (a computer); to press Ctrl-Alt-Delete

ex.zh: 我需要一把新的牙刷。
ex.p: wǒ xū yào yī bǎ xīn de yá shuā
ex.en: I need a new toothbrush.

ex.zh: 哪把是我的牙刷？
ex.p: nǎ bǎ shì wǒ de yá shuā
ex.en: Which one is my toothbrush?

ex.zh: 这本课本很好。
ex.p: zhè běn kè běn hěn hǎo
ex.en: This is a good textbook.

items.en: to be a guest or visitor

ex.zh: 我把她的字典还给了她。
ex.p: wǒ bǎ tā de zì diǎn hái gěi le tā
ex.en: I gave her her dictionary back.

ex.zh: 我能用一下你的字典吗？
ex.p: wǒ néng yòng yī xià nǐ de zì diǎn ma
ex.en: Can I use your dictionary for a minute?

ex.zh: 我明年想出国留学。
ex.p: wǒ míng nián xiǎng chū guó liú xué
ex.en: I want to study abroad next year.

ex.zh: 他出国留学了。
ex.p: tā chū guó liú xué le
ex.en: He studied abroad.

ex.zh: 少了一把勺子。
ex.p: shǎo le yī bǎ sháo zi
ex.en: There is a spoon missing.

ex.zh: 把勺子给我。
ex.p: bǎ sháo zi gěi wǒ
ex.en: Give me the spoon.

ex.zh: 请在词典里查这个词。
ex.p: qǐng zài cí diǎn lǐ zhā zhè gè cí
ex.en: Please look up this word in a dictionary.

ex.zh: 为什么你买了一本那么贵的词典？
ex.p: wèi shén me nǐ mǎi le yī běn nà me guì de cí diǎn
ex.en: Why did you buy such an expensive dictionary?

ex.zh: 今天很凉快。
ex.p: jīn tiān hěn liáng kuai
ex.en: It's cool today.

ex.zh: 您最好穿一件雨衣。
ex.p: nín zuì hǎo chuān yī jiàn yǔ yī
ex.en: You'd better put on a raincoat.

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 3 · 第45单元

Telling a story

Grammar focus: 突然, 终于, 后来; 才 vs 就

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

lessons.title: 留学、勺子、方便面、羽毛球…
大熊猫、雨衣、留学生、高铁…

sents.zh: 我需要一把新的牙刷。
sents.p: wǒ xū yào yī bǎ xīn de yá shuā
sents.en: I need a new toothbrush.

sents.zh: 哪把是我的牙刷？
sents.p: nǎ bǎ shì wǒ de yá shuā
sents.en: Which one is my toothbrush?

sents.zh: 这本课本很好。
sents.p: zhè běn kè běn hěn hǎo
sents.en: This is a good textbook.

sents.zh: 我把她的字典还给了她。
sents.p: wǒ bǎ tā de zì diǎn hái gěi le tā
sents.en: I gave her her dictionary back.

sents.zh: 我能用一下你的字典吗？
sents.p: wǒ néng yòng yī xià nǐ de zì diǎn ma
sents.en: Can I use your dictionary for a minute?

sents.zh: 我明年想出国留学。
sents.p: wǒ míng nián xiǎng chū guó liú xué
sents.en: I want to study abroad next year.

sents.zh: 他出国留学了。
sents.p: tā chū guó liú xué le
sents.en: He studied abroad.

sents.zh: 少了一把勺子。
sents.p: shǎo le yī bǎ sháo zi
sents.en: There is a spoon missing.

sents.zh: 把勺子给我。
sents.p: bǎ sháo zi gěi wǒ
sents.en: Give me the spoon.

sents.zh: 请在词典里查这个词。
sents.p: qǐng zài cí diǎn lǐ zhā zhè gè cí
sents.en: Please look up this word in a dictionary.

sents.zh: 为什么你买了一本那么贵的词典？
sents.p: wèi shén me nǐ mǎi le yī běn nà me guì de cí diǎn
sents.en: Why did you buy such an expensive dictionary?

sents.zh: 今天很凉快。
sents.p: jīn tiān hěn liáng kuai
sents.en: It's cool today.

sents.zh: 您最好穿一件雨衣。
sents.p: nín zuì hǎo chuān yī jiàn yǔ yī
sents.en: You'd better put on a raincoat.
